settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most U.S. orders ship within 1 business day and arrive in 3-7 business days. You'll get a tracking number by email as soon as your order leaves the warehouse.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange a product?
settings.answer: Yes — we offer a no-fuss 30-day return policy on unused items in original packaging. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

settings.question: How do I find the right size for my pet?
settings.answer: Each product page includes a sizing guide. If you're between sizes or unsure, email us with your pet's measurements and we'll recommend the best fit.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship within the United States. International shipping is on our roadmap — sign up for our newsletter to hear when it launches.

settings.question: Is my payment information secure?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Payments are processed through Shopify's PCI-compliant checkout with end-to-end encryption. We never see or store your card details.

settings.question: How do I contact you?
settings.answer: Email hello@pawessentials.com or use our contact form. We reply within one business day.
